test_case.test_name: Parameterized ConnectX Ethernet300-second iperf throughput validation
test_case.purpose: Measure five-minute Ethernet throughput over the exact ConnectX port/path with distinct SUT-server and peer-client endpoints and verify link and host health.
required_package: SUT/peer NIC BDF/interface/port/MAC/IP/VLAN/MTU/route and isolated Ethernet path
Driver/firmware, negotiated speed/FEC/autoneg and NUMA/CPU/power profile
Approved compatible iperf v2 or v3 artifacts on both endpoints
test_case.test_command: Capture both endpoint identities, routes, link and counter baselines; verify the test traverses the designated physical Ethernet path and not loopback; start the approved SUT server and record readiness/PID; from the distinct peer run the approved client to the explicit SUT IP for300 seconds with60-second intervals; retain complete server/client output, CPU/thermal and before/after counters; stop only the recorded server and restore firewall/path changes.
test_case.expected_result: All approved intervals and final result meet the bound Ethernet thresholds with acceptable retransmit/loss/error deltas; negotiated link, NIC and both hosts remain healthy after cleanup.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires distinct endpoints, exact physical path/profile, complete two-ended evidence and all approved thresholds. Missing profile/threshold, loopback, truncated output, unexpected counter growth or health regression is BLOCKED/FAIL.
safety_gate: Confirm isolated non-production Ethernet path and explicit peer/SUT roles.
Pin compatible tool versions; do not download an unqualified latest build.
Abort on path drift, link flap, error storm, thermal/CPU limit or production impact.
Track PID and restore only test-created firewall/process state.
expected_evidence: Tool versions/hashes and exact server/client commands
Before/after NIC counters plus CPU/thermal/system logs
Versioned threshold comparison and cleanup/final health
test_case.recovery: On path/link/host fault, stop the recorded client/server without broad process kills, preserve evidence, restore test firewall/routing state and verify both NICs and hosts; no automatic rerun.
